## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (and fail without it, for a fix)
- [ ] Public API changes are recorded in `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` and are intentional
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`, READMEs) and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated
- [ ] Behavior changes are listed under **Changed** in the changelog and in `docs/migration.md`
- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass locally (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
